name: equisplit-workspace
description: EquiSplit - Intelligent Shared Expense & Debt Simplification Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
